description.text: The three Sun & Moon Starter Sets, Decidueye-GX, Incineroar-GX and Primarina-GX, released in Korean on 12 January 2017. Each held a 60-card deck with two holo cards, a two-player playmat, damage counters and markers, a GX marker, a Pokémon coin (first print run only) and a rule book.
